LAPLACE TRANSFORMS (p.1025)
f(s)  F(t)
29.3.58  (\sqrt{s^2+a^2}-s)^k \quad (k>0)  \frac{ka^k}{t}J_k(at) \quad ^9
29.3.59  \frac{(s-\sqrt{s^2-a^2})^\nu}{\sqrt{s^2-a^2}} \quad (\nu>-1)  a^\nu I_\nu(at) \quad ^9
29.3.60  \frac{1}{(s^2-a^2)^k} \quad (k>0)  \frac{\sqrt\pi}{\Gamma(k)}\left(\frac{t}{2a}\right)^{k-\tfrac12} I_{k-\tfrac12}(at) \quad ^{6,10}
29.3.61  \frac1s e^{-ks}  u(t-k) \quad [FIGURE: unit step rising from 0 to 1 at t=k]
29.3.62  \frac{1}{s^2}e^{-ks}  (t-k)u(t-k)
29.3.63  \frac{1}{s^\mu}e^{-ks} \quad (\mu>0)  \frac{(t-k)^{\mu-1}}{\Gamma(\mu)}u(t-k) \quad ^6 \quad [FIGURE: rectangular pulse, 0 to k]
29.3.64  \frac{1-e^{-ks}}{s}  u(t)-u(t-k)
29.3.65  \frac{1}{s(1-e^{-ks})}=\frac{1+\coth \tfrac12ks}{2s}  \sum_{n=0}^\infty u(t-nk) \quad [FIGURE: ascending staircase, steps at 0,k,2k]
29.3.66  \frac{1}{s(e^{ks}-a)}  \sum_{n=1}^\infty a^{n-1}u(t-nk) \quad [FIGURE: ascending staircase with growing step heights, steps at k,2k,3k]
29.3.67  \frac1s \tanh ks  u(t)+2\sum_{n=1}^\infty (-1)^nu(t-2nk) \quad [FIGURE: square wave alternating +1/-1, period 4k]
29.3.68  \frac{1}{s(1+e^{-ks})}  \sum_{n=0}^\infty (-1)^nu(t-nk) \quad [FIGURE: square pulse train, on for [0,k], off [k,2k], on [2k,3k]]
29.3.69  \frac{1}{s^2}\tanh ks  tu(t)+2\sum_{n=1}^\infty (-1)^n(t-2nk)u(t-2nk) \quad [FIGURE: triangular wave, period 4k]
29.3.70  \frac{1}{s\sinh ks}  2\sum_{n=0}^\infty u[t-(2n+1)k] \quad [FIGURE: ascending staircase with step height 2, steps at k,3k,5k]
29.3.71  \frac{1}{s\cosh ks}  2\sum_{n=0}^\infty (-1)^nu[t-(2n+1)k] \quad [FIGURE: alternating pulse train, height 2, period 4k]
note: Continuation of the f(s)|F(t) table, 29.3.58-29.3.71 (Bessel-function transforms, then step/periodic functions u(t-k)). Entries 29.3.61-29.3.71 each carry a small step-waveform diagram alongside F(t) -- marked [FIGURE], since the closed-form u(t-k) expression already IS the transcribable content the diagram illustrates.
